Love driving and looking for a great job? Jump into the cabin of a modern truck! As a C/CE Driver at Bakkerij Visser in Alphen aan den Rijn, you are the face of a family business. You will drive routes to deliver fresh bread to supermarkets every day. And the rewards? Very good! You get a great salary (Bakery CAO) plus extra money for working night hours. Enjoy a flexible job with a good work-life balance, and we will take care of your yearly Code 95 training. Ready to hit the road? 🌍

- €18.21 to €22.12 per hour (excluding allowances)!

Who you are
Would you love to work as a driver in a family business? As our driver, you make sure the fresh bread gets to the customers right on time. You are exactly the person we are looking for if you:

- Have a valid C or CE driving license.

- Speak and write good Dutch or English.

What will you do
What does your workday look like?

- Early start & coffee: Start your day between 01:30 and 04:00 AM at the bakery in Alphen aan den Rijn with a hot cup of coffee.
- Load up: Load your truck independently with carts of delicious, fresh-smelling bread.
- Hit the road: Drive a fixed route to about 5 or 6 supermarkets (like Jumbo).
- Deliver & handle admin: Unload neatly at the dock, check the delivery notes, take back empty returns, and fill in your trip reports.
- Done by 10:00 AM! Park the truck back at the bakery and enjoy having the rest of the day completely free! 🥖

- A proud history: You will join Bakkerij Visser in Alphen aan den Rijn, a modern industrial family business that has been around for over 100 years! As part of the Bake Five group, they bake fresh bread for major supermarkets every day.
